name: Mr. Halen (Ba Sing Se)
canon_status: Author-created fanfiction character; not a licensed franchise character

biography.on_page: Older regular Jasmine Dragon customer temporarily absent while grieving his sister; chooses how much of their letters to share
biography.unwritten: No family history, motives, exact age or prior life beyond the manuscripts and cited author references should be invented.

personality.voice: Wry, exacting, matter-of-fact, complains about tea and sweeping while retaining his fierce right to privacy.
personality.decision_making: Can decline visits, letters being read, surprise check-ins and public grief narratives; his shop attendance belongs to him.
contradictions: A separate author-created person from Halen named in the Lanternweald Jasmine Steps registry, barring explicit future identification.

relationships.Jasper: Interactions reflect their role and agency; neither friendship nor partnership is assumed.

voice_and_consent_rules: Dialogue must arise from character-specific skills, conflicts and responsibilities.
No inaccessible knowledge, unresolved mystery solution or invented family biography.
Jasper's adult polyamorous romance must not make these supporting residents romantic participants by assumption.
The living-world community retains labor, privacy and safety boundaries.
